outcome: Maternal and fetal vascular malformations (MVM, FVM)
Maternal clinical and laboratory signs of chorioamnionitis (CA)
cohort: The study investigated 237 preterm infants born at or before 32 weeks gestation or with a birthweight at or below 1500g, comparing those born from meconium-stained amniotic fluid to those born from clear amniotic fluid.
finding: Meconium-stained amniotic fluid in preterm pregnancies is associated with a severe maternal and fetal inflammatory response in the placenta and umbilical cord, elevated systemic inflammatory parameters, and a higher incidence of severe neonatal intraventricular hemorrhage.
followup_time: Early neonatal period (up to the second day of life for some markers, and for early neonatal outcomes)
